# Score Anchor

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ScoreAnchor`](gmeow-ScoreAnchor.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ScoreAnchor>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A pinned score range with its meaning and exemplars — 'range 0.8–1.0 means the text embodies the covenant, as in THIS passage'. Anchors are the rubric's calibration content; interpolation between anchors is solver work ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ScoreAnchor`](gmeow-ScoreAnchor.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to pin a score range to its meaning and exemplars — the rubric's calibration content that anchors what a number means.

### Avoid when

- Avoid encoding interpolation between anchors in triples (that is solver work — [Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)) and avoid an anchor without a meaning (an anchor without [`gmeow:anchorMeaning`](../properties/gmeow-anchorMeaning.md) is just an interval).

### How to use

- Mint the anchor with [`gmeow:anchorRangeMin`](../properties/gmeow-anchorRangeMin.md) / [`gmeow:anchorRangeMax`](../properties/gmeow-anchorRangeMax.md) and a mandatory [`gmeow:anchorMeaning`](../properties/gmeow-anchorMeaning.md), attach exemplars via [`gmeow:anchorExemplar`](../properties/gmeow-anchorExemplar.md), and link it to a criterion with [`gmeow:hasScoreAnchor`](../properties/gmeow-hasScoreAnchor.md).

### Examples

- ex:a1 a [`gmeow:ScoreAnchor`](gmeow-ScoreAnchor.md); [`gmeow:anchorRangeMin`](../properties/gmeow-anchorRangeMin.md) 0.8; [`gmeow:anchorRangeMax`](../properties/gmeow-anchorRangeMax.md) 1.0; [`gmeow:anchorMeaning`](../properties/gmeow-anchorMeaning.md) "embodies the covenant"@en.
